mentioned.quote: Cyber offense, including model capabilities that could enable or enhance attacks on computer systems, networks, or digital infrastructure.

threshold.quote: Meaningful technical assistance for active cyber operations using known attack techniques and methodologies. Some automation is involved, but still requires human input to complete successful large cyber-operations.
threshold.note: Cyber Offense Tier 1; tiers trigger safeguards ('When a model reaches a particular risk tier, we implement safeguards', p.6). Tier 2 p.6-7.

response.quote: Provided the residual risk falls within acceptable levels, taking into account appropriate safety margins, the model is approved for continued development, internal use (where applicable), and launch (as the case may be).
response.note: Generic acceptance gate (E3), present-tense conditional rule (E1). Tier-triggered safeguards on p.6 are 'proportionate' and listed only as 'may include', so they do not count by themselves.

acc_decider.note: Approval for launch is unattributed (p.11); 'the justification for proceeding will be documented by the risk owner' (p.11) names an undefined role that documents, not decides. Board of Anthropic Ireland only 'oversees implementation' for EU purposes (p.15); Responsible Scaling Officer named only as a proposer of Framework updates (p.15).

acc_external.note: p.14 'We may solicit input from external actors' (hedged); p.13 security controls 'independently reviewed' is undated present-tense practice about Anthropic's own security (E1), not tied to this risk; bug bounty on p.10 is under 'we may rely on'. No binding external review.

acc_unmet.quote: if we identify any instances of non-adherence or any measures that are required to be implemented to ensure continued adherence, we will draft and implement a remediation plan.
acc_unmet.note: Framework-wide non-compliance procedure, limited to compliance with the EU Code; remediation plans feed updates presented to the board of Anthropic Ireland (p.16). Ambiguous fit to C6(b), which lists reporting, investigation or disclosure.

mentioned.quote: Chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear (CBRN) threats.

threshold.quote: Non-novel chemical/biological weapons production. threshold.note: CBRN Tier 1; Tier 2 novel weapons on p.7.
